title: The proposal
summary: Weeks after meeting, he proposes; she waits to see if he means it sober; no divorce papers means they must marry in Germany.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now after the War you two formed what a combo or how large a group did you have?
We had a quartet at first, but Marian, I would like to tell you what happened.

What happened actually was, just before the Bulge, this is, now we're in November of '44. And just before the Bulge, why we were together for about four or five weeks and she was the greatest to me. I fell in love with her and I told her, you know. I said look honey, let's get married. I said, if it doesn't work out you know, you can always go back home. But let's get married any way. Come to America with me, you know. (LAUGHTER).

And so she said, well, I drank a lot in those days. I don't any more, but I drank a lot in those days. She said, oh, that's drink talking. She said, I'll see you the first thing in the morning and I'll come over to your hotel and see you and see if you feel the same way. And she did. And I said, yes, I do, you know, good, alright while I was sober.
